SELECT p.code AS "code", p.name AS "name", p.spec AS "spec", NULLIF(TRIM(p.food_type), '') AS "foodType", COALESCE( (SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'FOOD_TYPE' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = TRIM(p.food_type) LIMIT 1), NULLIF(TRIM(p.food_type), '')) AS "foodTypeNm" FROM products p WHERE COALESCE(p.discontinued, 0) = 0
AND (p.name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.code ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')
AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.food_type), '') IS NOT NULL
AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.food_type), '') IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(p.food_type), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, p.name, p.code LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS "total", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(p.food_type), '') IS NOT NULL)::int AS "typed" FROM products p WHERE COALESCE(p.discontinued, 0) = 0

SELECT ps.id AS "lotId", ps.lot_no AS "lotNo", ps.schedule_date AS "madeOn", ps.product_code AS "productCode", COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pr.name), ''), ps.product_code) AS "productName", NULLIF(TRIM(pr.food_type), '') AS "foodType", COALESCE( (SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'FOOD_TYPE' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = TRIM(pr.food_type) LIMIT 1), NULLIF(TRIM(pr.food_type), '')) AS "foodTypeNm", pr.net_weight AS "netWeight", pr.shelf_life_months AS "shelfLifeMonths", pr.shelf_life_unit AS "shelfLifeUnit", pr.storage AS "storage", ps.actual_qty AS "actualQty", ps.order_qty AS "orderQty", ps.logistics_date AS "logisticsDate", ps.is_stock_production AS "stockProduction", (SELECT string_agg(ls.schedule_date, ' / ' ORDER BY ls.schedule_date) FROM logistics_schedule ls WHERE ls.lot_id = ps.id AND COALESCE(ls.ship_confirmed, 0) <> 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(ls.schedule_date), '') IS NOT NULL) AS "doneShipDates", (SELECT string_agg(ls.schedule_date, ' / ' ORDER BY ls.schedule_date) FROM logistics_schedule ls WHERE ls.lot_id = ps.id AND COALESCE(ls.ship_confirmed, 0) = 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(ls.schedule_date), '') IS NOT NULL) AS "plannedShipDates" FROM production_schedule ps LEFT JOIN products pr ON pr.code = ps.product_code WHERE 1 = 1
AND NULLIF(TRIM(ps.actual_qty), '') IS NOT NULL
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logistics_schedule ls2 WHERE ls2.lot_id = ps.id AND ls2.schedule_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) OR ps.logistics_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end})
AND ps.schedule_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
ORDER BY ps.schedule_date DESC, ps.id DESC LIMIT 300
